claim: local rung1 evidence classification; no model calls, execution experiment or scores
decision_scope: Reject the current source-proven executable event-ledger mainline at its predeclared gate; this is not a benchmark ceiling or a claim that future evidence cannot resolve exclusions.

inputs.structural_semantic_boundary: E34 confirms references only. E33 accepts two source findings without label flips or scores. Other case diagnoses remain specialist proposals, independently reviewable.

proof_contract.operator_requirement: The whole answer derivation must preserve each required operand binding and the query's scope. A positive witness can refute a missing-fact assertion without proving an exhaustive count, latest state, unique referent or semantic absence.
proof_contract.extraction_requirement: A validated source-to-operand artifact must establish the same complete derivation. Human recognition of an event in an audit is not an implemented, verified extraction result.
proof_contract.coverage_requirement: Keyword matches, has_answer markers, full selected sessions and citation existence do not establish exhaustive semantic coverage. Unknown is not false.
proof_contract.historical_reader_requirement: No attribution of a failure specifically to the deterministic operator is established merely by seeing the fact in the full source; the actual retained prompt was not preserved.

counts.sensitivity_meaning: Even the unsupported blanket acceptance of all six provisionally diagnosed reader-error cases would remain below11/21. This is a sensitivity check on the present classification, not an upper bound on future audit findings.

decision_reasons: The unchanged source-complete proof gate is not met.
Validated extraction evidence for the required end-to-end operand proofs is absent; the card independently requires rejection on this condition.
Wrong-gold findings and correct or qualified historical reader computations are excluded from claimed mechanism gains.
Unresolved cases remain in the fixed denominator21; none is silently dropped or relabeled to rescue the threshold.
